dialogues.jp: チャイムが鳴り、教室にざわめきが戻る。
dialogues.en: The chime rang, and noise returned to the classroom.
dialogues.text: The chime rang, and noise returned to the classroom.

dialogues.jp:
テスト用紙を回収して、試験監督の講師が教室
から出て行く。
dialogues.en:
After taking back all the exam papers, the invigilating
teacher left the room.
dialogues.text:
After taking back all the exam papers, the invigilating
teacher left the room.

dialogues.jp:
昼休みといえど、自習時間みたいなものだ。周
りでは、弁当をつつきながら、教科書を眺め、
友達に質問したりしている。
dialogues.en:
The lunch break was time for more self-studying, apparently.
All around me, my classmates were either eating and
studying.
dialogues.text:
The lunch break was time for more self-studying, apparently.
All around me, my classmates were either eating and
studying.

dialogues.jp:
飯を食いながら教科書を開いているやつらばか
りが、目立つ。いよいよ第四コーナーが見えて
きたわけだが――
dialogues.en:
As expected, everyone was eating and studying at the same
time. The fourth corner was almost in sight for everyone...
dialogues.text:
As expected, everyone was eating and studying at the same
time. The fourth corner was almost in sight for everyone...

dialogues.jp: さて、俺はどうするかな。
